purpose: Determine whether RBI publishes the auction-method and weighted-average-price fields needed to qualify retail noncompetitive 91-day Treasury-bill acquisitions.

primary_sources.title: RBI Government Securities FAQ
primary_sources.relevant_rule: Noncompetitive allotments are at the weighted-average price/yield of successful competitive bids; retail participation is through an authorized aggregator/facilitator, including Retail Direct as stated in the auction notice.

sample.auction_notice_says_retail_route: RBI Retail Direct portal available for individuals; retail allocation capped at up to 5% of notified amount.
sample.ncb_price_basis: weighted-average successful competitive price/yield under RBI FAQ; do not substitute the cutoff in a multiple-price auction.

retrieval_and_integrity.review_method: Official RBI source pages captured sequentially by the bounded GitHub Actions workflow, including the public year/month form using hdnYear=2025 and hdnMonth=11. Exact response bytes, retrieval time, URL, byte count, and SHA-256 are retained in the source manifest.
retrieval_and_integrity.limitation: One historical result and one current auction source chain are captured. This does not constitute the complete Table 218 date-matched panel, a continuous 91-day bill return series, or an investor-specific retail acquisition/rollover record.
retrieval_and_integrity.sha256_scope: Historical result sample full_result_prid61683.html; all captured files have separate hashes in the source manifest.

decision_use.route_feasible: yes; the official public archive form can be queried by year/month, and archive result links resolve to detailed per-auction HTML with weighted-average prices/yields.
remaining_work: Capture the full historical set of official month pages and T-bill notice/full-result pairs for the dates used; reconcile each to Table 218 or an authoritative official export.
Qualify contemporaneous auction method and the applicable retail NCB price for each auction; preserve missing, revised, cancelled, and zero-allotment cases as explicit exceptions.
Model eligible subscription, partial allotments, settlement, maturity/redemption, reinvestment, idle cash, service charges, tax, and any applicable execution constraints.
Keep direct dated GoI bond price/coupon/reinvestment inputs separate from bill and fund NAV/index observations.

historical_result_sample.title: Treasury Bills: Full Auction Result
historical_result_sample.auction_method: Not established for this historical auction; the contemporaneous notice/result pair has not yet been captured.
historical_result_sample.amount_unit: ₹ crore; prices per ₹100 face value; yields as published by RBI
